title: eurycorymbus cavaleriei
intro: Eurycorymbus cavaleriei, commonly known as Chinese Angelica, is a plant species in the family Apiaceae. This plant is used in traditional Chinese medicine, valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immune-modulating properties. The therapeutic actions of Eurycorymbus cavaleriei may include analgesia, anti-anxiety, and anti-hemorrhagic effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include coumarins, lignans, and sesquiterpenes, although further research is needed to confirm the exact composition and effects.
